'''Narigus III''' was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="Kubaz" /> located in the [[Narigus system/Legends|Narigus system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At one point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the individuals [[Lauren]] and [[Sam]] stole the valuable art piece known as the [[Kubaz Insect]] from the [[Collector/Legends|collector]] [[Rock'co]] on Narigus III. They then attempted to smuggle the artifact offworld on their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] but were eventually forced to separate due to being pursued by a group of thugs, ultimately ending up in a large [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]]. Afterward, Rock'co himself also traveled to the city in search of the thieves.<ref name="Kubaz" />

==Behind the scenes==
Narigus III was mentioned in "[[The Kubaz Insect]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure hook published in [[Bill Olmesdahl]]'s [[1992]] supplement ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Screen]]'' for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Kubaz" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Narigus [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Narigus III, in grid square O-6.<ref name="TEA" />
